title: 3× inconsistent return statements (R1710) — functions at lines 124, 137, 207
detail: 3 functions have code paths that return a value and paths that fall through implicitly. Callers expecting a return value silently receive `None` on the implicit path, a latent `AttributeError` or `TypeError` risk. Fix: add explicit `return None` on all implicit paths, or normalize return type.
